content.title: How to watch Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special on Disney+
content.text: Updated March 24, 2026, 9:27 a.m. ETMiley Cyrus is returning to Disney for a "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special."The special will feature Cyrus reflecting on the show with "Call Her Daddy" podcast host Alex Cooper.You can stream the anniversary special exclusively on Disney+ starting Tuesday, March 24.A promotional bundle for Disney+ and Hulu is available for new and eligible returning customers.We're getting the best of both worlds when Miley Cyrus returns to Disney to relive her years as Hannah Montana.It's not the first time the popstar returns to her roots—back in 2023, Cyrus and Disney released a video series "Endless Summer Vacation (Backyard Sessions)." This time, however, she'll be joined by "Call Her Daddy" podcast host Alex Cooper where the singer will reflect on the creation and impact of the series. You can stream the Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special on Disney+ on Tuesday, March 24 at 3 a.m. ET.Plus, right now, you can get a Disney+ and Hulu bundle for just $4.99 for the first three months.
